intro.text: An Alethi scribe training to be an engineer.

items.text: When Adolin asked whether a balcony in the Azish Dome could take a Shardbearer's weight, Kaminah sent Gitora to check because of her engineering training. She reported back that it could, since the Azish Shardbearer was already standing on it, and she had done the extra maths to be sure it would hold them both.
